verdict.rationale: AMD provides official Ryzen AI SDKs (ONNX Runtime + Vitis AI EP, AMD Quark quantization, Lemonade SDK, GAIA agent framework) with documented Python/C++/C# APIs, pre-optimized LLMs, and app development guides, giving AI-native developers real official SDKs to build against. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of SDK stability/adoption and no formal API reference (e.g., OpenAPI) confirming completeness beyond docs pages.
